title: Nifas Silk-Lafto Sub-City Moving Overview
excerpt: Nifas Silk-Lafto from Jemo to Lebu: southwest Addis condo belts, Gotera ring-road traffic, long internal distances, and how quotes change by sub-area.
content:
Nifas Silk-Lafto in one map

Nifas Silk-Lafto sub-city stretches south and southwest—Jemo, Lebu, Lafto, and edges toward Sarbet and Gotera. It is one of the largest residential zones in Addis. A move from Jemo 1 to Lebu 3 can be a long internal leg even though both addresses share the same sub-city name. Quotes always ask for both gate locations, not just “Nifas Silk.”

Common move patterns

  • Upgrading from Mexico or Sarbet rentals into larger Jemo condos.
  • Lebu gated villas with long carries from boulevard to house door.
  • Cross-town employment moves toward Bole or Kazanchis—traffic via Gotera interchange.
  • Student and young-professional studios near commercial strips—small volume, tight timing.

Ring road and Gotera

Most exits toward inner city cross the Gotera interchange. Rush-hour delays are normal—see our Gotera guide and Jemo & Lebu guide for staging tips. Mid-week loads help when compounds allow weekday freight.

Condo logistics

Tower moves need lift booking, move permits, and ID lists. End-of-month stacks elevator demand—book early. Use the condo checklist for handover photos and meter readings.

Pricing

Distance inside the sub-city still affects crew hours. Starting prices for typical units are on our 2026 cost guide. Pairing neighbors on the same compound can share mobilization—group move tips.

Sarbet and Mexico adjacency

Households upgrading from Sarbet or Mexico Square rentals into Jemo towers often underestimate carry time inside the new compound—long walks from boulevard to tower lobby add crew hours. Survey photos of both gates prevent day-of surprises.

Office spillover

Small offices along Lebu and Sarbet commercial strips sometimes share move days with residential tenants. After-hours loading and labeled IT cartons keep downtime low—office relocation from 45,000 ETB with inventory lists.

Long internal legs

A Jemo-to-Lebu move can cross much of the sub-city; do not assume “same woreda” means a short truck run. Fixed quotes should reference both compound names and approximate carry distance from gate to door. When in doubt, choose a capped hourly structure explained in our pricing guide.

Broker warning

Southwest compounds see high delala traffic at month-end—broker vs professional before you pay cash at the gate.

Cross to Bole employment

Nifas Silk households commuting to Bole should start load early—Gotera interchange delay is common—Gotera guide.
